china-1914:p0124_1.rationale: Directory of smelting works (antimony, copper, iron, tin, metal) by name and location; text-only. Mixed metals so no single metal tag; iron-and-steel covers only one works, but is the closest smelting tag.
review_questions: Is a non-ferrous metal smelting tag needed? Iron-and-steel fits only one works.
